description: STUCK_FINALIZE_NUDGE is the harder instruction of the pair — it tells the model to stop calling tools outright and write the answer. Same evidential gap as loop-nudge: the hook wiring is pinned, the effect is not. Running both against the same task shows which wording actually lands, which is the comparison the current tests cannot make.

tasks.description: Identical task and afterSteps to the loop-nudge pack on purpose, so the two nudges are directly comparable on one report.
tasks.prompt: Look through this project and tell me what the modules under src/ have in common.
